title: Vicky Pattison Announces Venture Into Wellness Podcasting
excerpt: Reality TV personality Vicky Pattison has announced an upcoming venture into wellness podcasting.
author: LokkeeVerse Editorial
content:
Reality television personality Vicky Pattison has announced a new project in the wellness podcast space. 

According to reports, the 38-year-old's move into wellness podcasting follows her recent disclosure that she is trying for a baby. Further details regarding the podcast's title, co-hosts, or release schedule were not immediately provided.
seoTitle: Vicky Pattison Announces New Wellness Podcast Venture
metaDescription: Reality television star Vicky Pattison has announced plans to launch a new wellness podcast.
